speech.heard: 143 out of 186 countries and territories have at least 50% internet usage. Yellow areas show 50% or more usage, while dark blue areas are below that. South Sudan has the world's lowest usage at 7%. Kuwait reaches 100%, while Nigeria sits at 41%. The metric counts individuals who have used the internet from any location in the last three months. Among these countries, India is at 70% and the USA is at 95%. So where does your country rank?
